quarterly_data.signal: 6-K board announcement: on July 29, 2026 UMC's board approved capital budget execution with a projected investment of NT$148,680 million, funded from working capital, for capacity deployment, together with a phased plan to install the cleanroom and purchase tools in the Singapore Phase 4 (P4) facility, whose building shell is already built, to expand silicon photonics capacity, and to construct a new fab building at the Tainan campus that will house future Phase 7 (P7) and Phase 8 (P8) facilities and expand UMC's advanced packaging footprint. The release says near-term capex is kept aligned with secured, long-term customer commitments and that the P4 expansion strengthens Singapore as UMC's largest site outside Taiwan. Chairman Stan Hung: the rise of generative AI is accelerating demand for technologies enabling higher performance, higher bandwidth and greater system integration.
quarterly_data.figure: NT$148,680 million capital budget execution approved (July 29, 2026) for capacity deployment

quarterly_data.signal: UMC's Q2 2026 consolidated financial statements: guarantee deposits (current portion included), which UMC says mainly consisted of deposits of capacity reservation, were NT$40,674,252 thousand at June 30, 2026 versus NT$40,867,857 thousand at December 31, 2025; UMC has entered into wafer fabrication contracts under which it shall provide agreed production capacity to customers. Construction contracts for the expansion of operations amounted to approximately NT$18.2 billion at June 30, 2026, of which approximately NT$12 billion was not yet recognized. Contract liabilities were NT$6,213,892 thousand at June 30, 2026 versus NT$4,368,164 thousand at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: capacity-reservation guarantee deposits NT$40,674,252 thousand; construction contracts NT$18.2 billion with NT$12 billion not yet recognized (June 30, 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K asset-acquisition announcement: UMC bought one batch of software (intangible assets) for production from Cadence Design Systems (Ireland) Limited Taiwan Branch between June 8 and July 29, 2026, for a total transaction price of NT$322,214,927, a non-related-party purchase decided by price negotiation against the market price.
